The LHHW reverse term uses the ideal-gas equilibrium constant of the kinetics spec (ln K fit) on a molarity basis (concentrations from PENG-ROB molar volumes in the molarity case), not fugacities, so the kinetic model equilibrates to a slightly different state than RGibbs (PENG-ROB fugacity based). The excess is largest at 40 bar. Not tuned; kept as a failure of this strict check. The Python PFR at the same conditions agrees within the conversion tolerance (item cat_<catalyst>_study_vs_python / cat_cv_*_vs_spec).
